common.name: Teethstone Ore
common.description: Dark ore broken from the jagged ridges. It rings like a struck pot when you drop it.

uncommon.name: Climber Moss
uncommon.description: A thick, peppery moss that grows on the shaded side of the pines. Climbers chew it for the cold.

rare.name: Frostvein Quartz
rare.description: Clear quartz threaded with white veins that look like frost and never melt.

drop.name: Gritmaw Hide
drop.description: A coarse hide studded with grit the climber rolled in for armor. It wears through a knife.

trophy.name: Gritmaw Molar
trophy.description: A flat, cracked molar the size of your palm. Hunters in the valley keep them on strings.

gear.name: Cliffhide Boots
gear.description: Soft boots with gritted soles, taken from a climber's last meal. They grip wet stone.

first.name: Gritmaw Jerkin
first.description: A heavy jerkin of gritted hide, lined with ore-dark thread.

second.name: Ashglass Cleaver
second.description: A cleaver of teethstone edged with ashglass. It cuts and then it keeps cutting.

third.name: Varrow Crown
third.description: A circlet of frostvein quartz set in rivet iron, bound with ashen moss and reedsilk.
